name: defuddle
tagline_zh: 粘贴链接，秒变干净 Markdown——导航、广告、弹窗全剥掉，只留正文。读文档、看文章，省一半 token。
tagline_en: Paste a URL, get clean Markdown—stripped of nav, ads, and popups. Save tokens on docs & articles. Smarter than.
desc_en: Extract clean markdown content from web pages using Defuddle CLI, removing clutter and navigation to save tokens. Use instead of WebFetch when the user provides a URL to read or analyze, for online documentation, articles, blog posts, or any standard web page. Do NOT use for URLs ending in .md — those are already markdown, use WebFetch directly.
why_zh: 同类工具只抓正文，它连阅读模式都省了——直接输出结构化 Markdown，且自动跳过 .md 链接。
why_en: Unlike simple extractors, it outputs structured Markdown and smartly skips .md URLs, leaving WebFetch to handle raw files.
